description: This file defines the DateValue class, a wizard for creating and managing date-based conditional formatting rules in PhpSpreadsheet, including predefined date periods such as yesterday, today, last week, etc.

classes.name: DateValue
classes.description: A wizard class for creating date-based conditional formatting rules based on predefined time periods, such as yesterday, today, last week, etc., with methods to generate and interpret Conditional objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DateValue wizard with a cell range.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Sets the operator type for the date condition, associated with specific time periods.

methods.name: setExpression
methods.description: Builds the expression string based on the selected operator and reference cell.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Creates and returns a Conditional object representing the current date-based conditional formatting rule.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates a DateValue wizard from an existing Conditional object, for editing or inspection.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to handle calls to undefined methods, mapping specific method names to predefined date operators.
